implementation.consent: clipVoiceConsent is account-scoped, server-validated and disabled by default. Every active voice participant is classified into included or excluded sets.
implementation.authorization: The server requires the recorder to be present in the exact server and voice channel before issuing or refreshing a recording session.
implementation.recording: The client mixes only consenting microphone publications into a local MediaRecorder stream and never uploads clip audio to the server.
implementation.live_changes: The client refreshes consent during recording, disconnects prior MediaStreamAudioSourceNode instances and rebuilds the mix from the latest included set.
implementation.audit: Start and stop events record the consent snapshot, recording identifier, channel and duration in the application log without recording audio content.
implementation.disposal: Stop and component cleanup clear polling, disconnect all media sources, close AudioContext and revoke replaced object URLs.
